specificationName: Instance Invariant Storage for Impulses and Activities

testCases.impulseId: validation-Instance Invariant Storage for Impulses and Activities-case-1
testCases.name: Cross-instance impulse access
validationCriteria: Instance A successfully creates impulse via vessel flow
Instance B retrieves the same impulse using same credentials
Retrieved data matches created data exactly
No local cache required on Instance B

testCases.impulseId: validation-Instance Invariant Storage for Impulses and Activities-case-2
testCases.name: Multi-tenant isolation

expectedOutput.isolationEnforced: at all 4 layers (opencode → CLI → API → DB)

validationCriteria: Tenant A creates impulse with id 'shared-impulse-name'
Tenant B creates impulse with same id 'shared-impulse-name'
Tenant A retrieves only their own data
Tenant B retrieves only their own data
Cross-tenant access attempt fails with 404/403
Backend enforces (api_key, project_id) scoping

testCases.impulseId: validation-Instance Invariant Storage for Impulses and Activities-case-3
testCases.name: Vessel boundary enforcement

input.checkFor: direct imports of metabob-rpc-api in opencode

validationCriteria: No direct imports of metabob-rpc-api modules in opencode
All rpc-api calls go through MCP layer (metabob-cli)
Vessel boundary maintained: opencode → CLI → rpc-api
No HTTP client code in opencode targeting rpc-api endpoints

testCases.impulseId: validation-Instance Invariant Storage for Impulses and Activities-case-4
testCases.name: Backend persistence validation
validationCriteria: Impulse persisted in SurrealDB via rpc-api
Data survives local cache clear
Backend retrieval works without local cache
Retrieved data matches original exactly
Backend is authoritative source of truth

testCases.impulseId: validation-Instance Invariant Storage for Impulses and Activities-case-5
testCases.name: Activity cross-instance load
validationCriteria: Instance A saves activity via metabob_activity_save MCP tool
Activity stored in backend with (api_key, project_id) scoping
Instance B local cache doesn't have activity
Instance B falls back to metabob_activity_load MCP tool
Backend returns activity successfully
Instance B caches activity locally after backend retrieval
